title: Construction team reviewing project plans
alt: Two construction professionals review paper plans beside a tablet at a jobsite workbench.
caption: Plan reviews connect field conditions, drawings, and the next decisions on a job.
prompt: Photorealistic documentary landscape: superintendent and project engineer reviewing paper plans and a rugged tablet at a plywood workbench on a commercial construction site; natural daylight, credible PPE, restrained colors, no logos or glossy AI look.

title: Contractor and office manager reviewing job costs
alt: An office manager and contractor review invoices with a calculator and laptop in a construction office.
caption: Review invoices, committed costs, and cash timing together before making project decisions.
prompt: Wide documentary photograph of an experienced female construction office manager and male contractor reviewing invoices and a calculator at a practical office desk; laptop, rolled plans, used hardhat, natural window daylight, ordinary work clothes, realistic skin and worn surfaces; no logos or text overlay.

title: Construction crew morning safety briefing
alt: A foreperson with a clipboard briefs four workers wearing hardhats, safety glasses and high visibility vests.
caption: A focused crew briefing connects the day’s work with its hazards and controls.
prompt: Documentary wide photograph of a construction foreperson briefing four workers at a commercial jobsite, accurate PPE, clipboard, steel framing, overcast daylight and natural expressions; no logos or CGI.

title: Project engineer documenting field conditions
alt: A project engineer in a hardhat and safety vest uses a rugged tablet beside steel wall framing.
caption: Capture field information where the work happens, then route it to the people who need it.
prompt: Documentary photograph of a construction project engineer using a rugged tablet at a safe interior inspection area, steel studs, realistic PPE, side profile and natural daylight; no readable interface, holograms or text overlays.

title: Contractor reviewing plans and permit documents
alt: A contractor and plan reviewer discuss drawings and permit paperwork across an office desk.
caption: Keep plans, permit requirements and approvals together when preparing construction work.
prompt: Documentary photo of a Black female contractor and gray-haired male plan reviewer discussing architectural drawings and permit papers in a modest office, natural daylight, realistic hands and work clothes, hardhat on desk; no official logos or seals.

title: Construction materials and equipment staging
alt: Strapped lumber, concrete blocks and a parked telehandler in a commercial construction staging area.
caption: Material quantities, delivery timing and equipment availability shape the next phase of work.
prompt: Wide documentary photograph of a quiet commercial jobsite staging area with strapped lumber, concrete blocks and a parked telehandler with lowered forks; realistic scale, gravel, unfinished building, overcast daylight, no people or logos.
